summary.text: William Conrad is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly representing District 140, which he has represented since January 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election on the Working Families Party and Democratic Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an educator by profession.

paragraphs.text: Conrad lives in Tonawanda, New York, and earned a bachelor's degree from Fredonia State College and a master's degree in education from Buffalo State College.
His career experience includes working as a social studies teacher, a coach, and a school department chair.
For the 2025-2026 session, Conrad was assigned to the Corporations, Authorities and Commissions; Education; Energy; Environmental Conservation; Local Governments; and Science & Technology committees.
